approved_scope: Run development Table 3 for B/C/D checkpoints 5 and 10 using the frozen four-class protocol. Use three GPUs in parallel, regenerate one same-runtime step-0 baseline, do not run Table 2 or other checkpoints.

runtime.network_policy: local artifacts with HF/Transformers offline and inherited proxy variables cleared

baseline_gate.policy: The fresh baseline must exactly match the frozen A correct/total counts before later waves are scheduled.
baseline_gate.provisional_policy: B5/C5 run concurrently with the baseline. On an exact-count mismatch, record the cause, delete only this run's provisional B5/C5 result directories, and stop.

dataset_order_repair.cause: English WAV bytes and names matched, but directory-entry order had changed; the frozen official-os-walk identity therefore differed.
dataset_order_repair.replacement_policy: Re-extracted in ZIP order after exact sorted file-hash equality check; retained the previous directory as a recoverable backup.

interruption_recovery_20260913.resume_bug: Legacy controller compared JSON-reloaded string checkpoint keys with in-memory integer keys and falsely reported identity mismatch.
interruption_recovery_20260913.resume_fix: JSON-normalize identities; allow only the known legacy controller hash migration; reject any unrelated drift.
interruption_recovery_20260913.partial_policy: Each running en/complete result, ASR cache, process log and traces was moved into its own interrupted-retry archive before a clean class restart.

owner_stop_policy_20260913.instruction: Stop the evaluation when only one GPU/checkpoint remains active.
owner_stop_policy_20260913.trigger: exactly one active_assignments entry in three consecutive manifest reads
owner_stop_policy_20260913.completed_before_monitor_start: B5/C5 all classes; D5/B10/C10 en complete and en incomplete
owner_stop_policy_20260913.stop_behavior: Terminate the main tmux, preserve all complete outputs, and leave any running class for the existing archive-on-resume path.

second_server_interruption_20260913.cause: server_or_container_disconnect while all three checkpoint assignments were still active; the stop-at-one policy did not trigger
second_server_interruption_20260913.completed_before_interruption: D5/B10/C10 en complete, en incomplete and zh complete
second_server_interruption_20260913.resume_policy: Reuse every complete class after identity validation; archive each partial zh/incomplete artifact and restart only that class.

single_active_stop_result.live_manifest_note: The controller-owned manifest intentionally remains status=running at stage D10 because the external owner-requested stop terminated it.
single_active_stop_result.receipt_status_note: The monitor initially stopped at status=stopping after matching the shared tmux server; read-only process/GPU reconciliation proved the evaluation was stopped, and the receipt was closed as stopped_reconciled.
single_active_stop_result.monitor_fix: Only Python controller/evaluation processes are now considered workload processes; tmux server processes are excluded.

owner_single_gpu_resume_20260913.instruction: Continue execution after reducing the container to one GPU.
owner_single_gpu_resume_20260913.reuse_policy: Identity-validate and reuse B5/B10/C5/C10/D5; evaluate only D10.
owner_single_gpu_resume_20260913.d10_previous_empty_artifacts: Archived by the existing interrupted-retry path before restart.

completion.interpretation: Joint balancing is best among B/C/D at both evaluated steps and mitigates A's Incomplete collapse, but no new candidate exceeds the official step-0 four-class macro baseline.

forbidden_actions: Do not change Table 3 samples, sample order, labels, ASR, decoding, terminal rule, thresholds, denominators or metrics.
Do not use Table 3 to alter training data, loss rates or checkpoint weights.
Do not run Table 2 or checkpoints other than 5 and 10.
Do not download models or call paid APIs.
next_action: Preserve the completed Table 3 evidence and final report read-only. Table 2 remains deferred and must not be started without a separately confirmed protocol.
